policy: Roadmap requirements are mapped to the existing Expo/React Native + Supabase architecture. Equivalent managed components are preferred over technology-for-technology rewrites. Real gaps remain explicit until implemented; production/provider facts remain external gates.

1_clean_architecture_offline_sync.note: Replay-safe social mutations use an account-bound SQLCipher queue; high-risk payment/legal/health/delete operations are intentionally excluded.

2_postgres_postgis_spatial.note: Private WGS-84 geography points + GiST/ST_DWithin are implemented. A private deterministic 40D pet feature embedding with pgvector/HNSW cosine ranking now reranks only after the mature authorization/privacy/mating/distance discovery gates; existing rules retain 70% of the score. Feed/Reels/default discovery use short-lived serverless Redis acceleration with current-Postgres reauthorization. Real Redis production credentials/metrics remain external.

3_auth_masvs_attestation.note: OAuth/MFA, App Attest, Play Integrity, secure storage, cleartext blocking, screen protection and local compromise risk signals are implemented. Certificate/SPKI pinning is intentionally not claimed until production host ownership, backup-pin rotation and managed-provider compatibility are evidence-backed.

4_social_matching_chat_ugc.note: Matching, pet-first grid/feed, 24h Stories, asymmetric chat, private realtime typing/read state, Pati Radar, report/block, deterministic text/OCR moderation, and production-source short-video/Reels are implemented. Reel publication is fail-closed until the configured moderation provider supplies the complete Tailmance policy contract plus a duration-verified, allowlisted sanitized MP4 derivative; live provider credentials and operational evidence remain external release gates.

5_health_trust_passport.note: Health documents enter a private AI/OCR queue. Provider output is strict-schema validated; <0.65 or invalid credential integrity rejects, 0.65–0.85/unverified routes to manual review, and >0.85 auto-verification still requires registry/credential integrity plus provenance-bound health attestations. AI decision metadata is private, exportable for owned documents, and erased with the document. Live registry/provider credentials, accuracy and operational SLA evidence remain external.

9_legal_devsecops_store.note: Legal/store/DevSecOps source controls are implemented. Store reviewer access uses ordinary production auth and store sandbox/license-test billing with no hardcoded credentials or entitlement bypass. Real reviewer account provisioning and console instructions remain an explicit external release gate.

11_webrtc_calls.note: Matched-pet LiveKit audio/video calls include source-level iOS CallKit + PushKit and Android self-managed Telecom/ConnectionService integration. Every user-callable call RPC is re-authorized against active session plus current legal/product access; terminal decline/end/expiry and account-deletion cascades transactionally enqueue a service-only room-teardown outbox, and a secret-protected reaper forcibly deletes LiveKit rooms with atomic claims and retry/backoff. Expo and APNs VoIP token transports remain isolated. Production LiveKit/TURN, real APNs VoIP credentials/delivery, scheduled room-reaper execution/monitoring, forced-disconnect outage/recovery drills and representative physical-device background/killed-state CallKit/Telecom QA remain external release evidence and are not represented as complete.

12_observability_tracing.note: Sentry native crash reporting includes low-sampled privacy-scrubbed navigation tracing and native slow/frozen frame tracking. Tailmance also records bounded anonymous aggregate JS frame windows through a private rate-limited RPC. All eight scheduled workers are now database-allowlisted for private heartbeat writes, and the service-only ops snapshot includes health-AI SLA/stale-lease and LiveKit teardown health counters. Real Sentry DSN, release source-map/symbol upload, scheduler and dashboard alert evidence remain external.

13_on_device_ai.note: Native Core ML/Vision and MediaPipe Tasks Vision runtimes are integrated into pet-photo flows. Local safety can block high-confidence unsafe media before upload but never replaces authoritative server moderation or authorizes cloud publication; there is no AI breed detection. Production artifacts, provenance/license, representative accuracy/bias/safety, and physical-device evidence including <=30 ms p95 warm inference remain fail-closed external gates.

14_bundle_on_demand_assets.note: Pet/social images are privacy-normalized and WebP re-encoded before upload; health/verification images remain JPEG for document interoperability. Static source assets are budget-gated and heavyweight video/model binaries are rejected. Android dynamic-feature/iOS ODR packaging is intentionally not claimed without measured release-build benefit and native artifact evidence.

15_universal_links.note: Pet profile, Reel and active Story Universal/App Links are source-implemented with strict URL parsing, legal/onboarding gating and server-authoritative visibility checks. Reel links honor discoverable/incognito privacy; Story links mirror current follower/own-pet visibility. Real Apple Team ID, Android Play signing fingerprints and hosted association files remain external production identity evidence.

16_store_automation_fastlane.note: Pinned Fastlane source automates read-only signing sync and fail-closed upload of EAS-signed IPA/AAB artifacts. Real multi-device screenshots remain a separate release-candidate QA gate and are not fabricated.

18_zero_trust_backend.note: Supabase managed Edge/RLS + provider perimeter is the current architecture. Istio/Vault are not inserted into a managed platform where they cannot control the provider data plane.

19_ha_disaster_recovery.note: Multi-region/failover/backup guarantees are deployment-provider facts, not source claims.

20_predictive_autoscaling_finops.note: KEDA is not applicable to the current managed Supabase data plane; workload scaling evidence belongs to the deployed provider architecture.

21_chaos_engineering.note: Deterministic source-level fault injection covers timeout, oversized/invalid payload, 429/5xx, bounded retry and idempotency behavior without touching production. Destructive provider/network chaos remains a staging-only external exercise; Chaos Mesh is not inserted into the managed Supabase data plane.
